question_summary: Domestic water riser detailing at Room 214 conflicts between Plumbing Fixture Schedule P-602 and Plumbing Detail 6/P503; clarification needed on which document governs the rough-in installation.
proposed_solution: Locate the domestic water riser per Plumbing Detail 6/P503; disregard the conflicting note in Plumbing Fixture Schedule P-602.
routing_rationale: The Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer is responsible for resolving conflicts between plumbing construction documents and approving which detail governs installation before field rough-in proceeds.
